header.superHtml:
As baby teeth bloom, the Turbo twins are wasting no time tarnishing tartar at lightning speeds with their battery-powered engines and supersoft bristles (each brush sold separately). As they soar into the mouths of children, their sonic waves massage and soothe sore gums, making this dynamic duo essential during teething and early childhood growth. When they've finished their mouth care magic, they return to Mama Turbo (sold separately), who dispenses toothpaste, cleanses the twins' brush heads with UV lights, and lulls them to sleep with her two-minute songs.

  • sonic toothbrush vibrates gently to soothe teething discomfort
  • brush tip contains a flashlight to see inside the mouth
  • super soft bristles remove plaque and clean gums
  • replaceable brush heads come in a range of sizes for growing mouths and varieties, including bristles, tongue scrapers, and gum massagers
  • recommended for ages: teething- 6 years
  • Mama Turbo Toothpaste dispenser sanitizes Turbo twins brush heads with UV light and plays four two-minute brushing songs (sold separately) — replaceable battery (requires one AAA battery)

reviews.name: Alysha
reviews.title: My 1 year old loves it
reviews.body: My one year old hasn’t been a fan of brushing. As a dental hygienist, it hurts my heart. I got this brush and he LOVES it. Big fan of the vibrations and I love the light so I can see his teeth.

reviews.name: Roberta
reviews.title: Quiet and Gentle
reviews.body:
I use it to brush my cat’s teeth after he was in need of three extractions. Works well in that he lets me in his mouth without too much struggle. 
If I was using it on a human I don’t know why you limit it to 3 yrs old. I would start as soon as there are teeth present. A six year old probably needs something a bit more robust since they are getting their permanent teeth.

reviews.name: Brittany
reviews.title: best toothbrush
reviews.body: I purchased two of these electric toothbrushes for my twin boys and they're absolutely amazing. It's their first electric toothbrushes, and they actually love them. The thick handle helps them hold it and they love the light which actually helps me see into their mouth better and look at their teeth better to make sure there's no food left behind. I would 100% recommend this toothbrush to anyone with kids. !!!

reviews.name: Roxana
reviews.title: Best gift for my neighbors daughter!!
reviews.body: My neighbors said their 2 yr old does not like to brush her teeth! I told them I've given this brush to my friends daughters and they said she loves it!!!

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: Mini Turbo
reviews.body: The perfect size for tiny mouths! And it’s so fun for them. Would recommend 1000x!
